# Exhibit photographs — Digital Showroom

Place three images here. They are hung on the showroom walls as framed
"works", each symbolising the value JUNK BRANDING makes visible for Japanese
businesses. Until the files exist, a painted procedural placeholder is shown.

## Files (required)

| File         | Theme | Subject                                                           |
| ------------ | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `craft.webp` | Craft | 日本の町工場・職人の手元・金属・工具・暖かい作業灯・静かな精度          |
| `space.webp` | Space | 日本の小さな飲食店 or 美容室の空間・木・柔らかい照明・静かな余白       |
| `trust.webp` | Trust | 士業/医療/専門職の相談机・書類・ペン・清潔な手元・信頼感             |

## Format

- Portrait orientation, roughly 4:5 (e.g. 1280×1600).
- `.webp`, quality ~80, kept reasonably small.
- The subject sits in the centre with negative space around it (it is framed
  on the wall, so the composition must work as a hung print).

## Look (shared conditions)

- 海外ストックフォト風にしない / AI生成っぽくしない
- 顔アップ禁止 / 握手禁止 / スーツ会議写真禁止
- ロゴ・文字・看板禁止 / ネオン・サイバーパンク禁止
- 暗く上質な展示空間に合う色調（deep navy / warm ivory / amber light）
- 余白を残す / 中央に主役 / 展示物として使える構図

## Swapping later

To use a different path or format, edit `EXHIBIT_SRC` in
`src/scenes/showroom/textures.ts`.
